idea-plugin.name: React Native Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Run React Native and Expo apps from a tool window without freezing the IDE: run on Android or iOS, start the dev server, and build a release, all built on OSProcessHandler, IntelliJ's own asynchronous process API -- specifically because the leading paid alternative has repeated, recent reports of freezing the IDE and requiring thread dumps to recover.

Works with both toolchains, detected from package.json: React Native CLI projects run react-native run-android / run-ios / start, and Expo projects -- the framework React Native's own docs recommend for new apps -- run expo run:android / run:ios / start.

Pick the Android device or iOS simulator to run on, from the real adb devices / xcrun simctl list devices output. One-click release builds, and environment profiles from your .env* files (ENVFILE, the react-native-config convention) for React Native CLI projects.
